name: gameflow
description: A durable, task-oriented game development workflow for Codex, Unreal Engine, Blender, and visual production tools.

interface.shortDescription: Durable agent workflows for game production
interface.longDescription: Initialize and operate resumable game projects through bounded tasks, explicit acceptance criteria, asset provenance, and disposable visual verification.
capabilities: Meshy MCP recipes and static asset production
Unreal integration and bounded CLI delegation
Milestones, epics, experiments and local-only evidence
Interactive blocker resolution within bounded autopilot runs
Prepared user verification with specific Yes/No approval criteria
defaultPrompt: Initialize GameFlow in this game project.
Resume this GameFlow project and pick the next task.
